minimalism: A minimalist illustration look: radically simplified essential shapes, sparse uncluttered composition with large empty areas, little or no shading and a restrained, quiet palette.
minimalist-line-art: A minimalist line-art look: a single confident continuous line with extreme economy, no shading or fill, controlled line weight and wide empty white space.
mixed-media: A mixed-media collage look: loose ink linework, translucent painterly and tea washes, torn-edge collaged paper fragments, textural bleeds and visibly layered handmade process.
modern-cartoon: A contemporary streaming-cartoon look: clean simplified outlines, streamlined geometric shapes, bright flat colour with only basic contact shadows and a crisp digital finish.
moebius-inspired-illustration: A clean ligne claire science-fantasy look: impossibly clean fluid linework, sparse delicate stippling and fine cross-hatching, soft pastel desert palettes and wide airy open space.
monet-style: An impressionist plein-air painting look: loose broken brushstrokes and dabs that blend optically, hazy light-drenched atmosphere and soft lilacs, water greens and pale golds.
mosaic-art: A tessellated mosaic look: countless small tile fragments each holding one flat colour, tone built from their density and arrangement, visible grout lines and a granular, glazed broken-tile texture.
motion-blur-photography: A long-exposure photography look: moving elements smeared into directional streaks and blurred trails, sharp frozen focal areas against them and a slow-shutter, light-painted texture.
movie-digital-art: An action-movie key-art look: photoreal composite rendering with graphic poster boldness, intensely saturated directional lighting, sharp aggressive contrast and strong diagonal energy.
muppets-style: A handmade puppet look: soft felt, fleece and foam textures, visible stitching and seams, oversized rounded simplified shapes and warm, even theatrical stage lighting.
murata-hyperrealism: A hyper-detailed manga look: obsessive near-photographic linework, high-contrast cross-hatched shadows carving sculptural volume and dense screentone, in crisp black ink.
my-hero-academia-style: A bold shōnen-anime look: clean confident linework, bright cel shading with punchy graphic contrast, crisp energy effects and speed lines, and a saturated, high-contrast palette.
national-geographic-photography: A documentary field-photography look: honest natural available light across a wide tonal range, rich saturated colour, crisp environmental detail and a polished editorial magazine finish.
natural-lighting-photography: A natural-light photography look: soft ambient available light with no artificial control, gentle shifting tonal balance, honest unforced rendering and subtle window-light dimensionality.
nickelodeon-animation-style: A 1990s cable-cartoon look: thick confident outlines, rubbery squash-and-stretch shapes, lopsided exaggerated design and bright, evenly saturated flat colour with minimal shading.
one-piece-style: A bold adventure-manga look: energetic elastic linework, exaggerated rubbery shapes, simplified cel shading favouring graphic readability and a bright, saturated, high-contrast palette.
origami: A folded-paper origami look: crisp angular planar folds, sharp crease lines, simple light-and-shadow contrast between adjoining facets and the matte texture of folded paper.
ornamental-patterns-hyperrealism-portrai: A hyperreal ornamental painting look: dense intricately repeating decorative motifs rendered with photographic precision and depth, raking light catching every raised contour and softly modelled surfaces.
paper-cutout: A layered paper-cutout look: flat crisp-edged paper shapes stacked with slight offsets, no drawn lines, small drop shadows between layers and visible matte paper texture.
peter-lindbergh-inspired-photography-sty: A raw humanist black-and-white fashion photography look: natural available light, soft yet high-contrast monochrome with deep blacks and luminous highlights, visible grain and minimal retouching.
photoshoot: A professional studio-photoshoot look: controlled key-and-fill lighting, clean even exposure across every plane, crisp focus and a polished, commercial-grade finish.
pin-up: A mid-century pin-up painting look: smooth confident linework, soft evenly blended airbrushed shading with a flattering luminous glow and warm, cheerful calendar-art colour on oil canvas.
pixar-animation: A 3D feature-animation look: smooth rounded volumetric modelling, warm subsurface-scattered materials with an inner glow, soft three-point lighting and gentle ambient occlusion.
playful-hand-drawn-illustration: A playful picture-book look: scratchy hand-inked pen lines with a warm imperfect touch, bright cheerful colour in loose watercolour and gouache washes and small doodle-like embellishments.
polished-ultrarealistic-anime-pin-up: A high-gloss anime-glamour look: ultrarealistic material rendering under idealized anime stylization, glassy lacquer-like specular highlights, airbrush-smooth gradients and vibrant saturated colour on softly blurred backdrops.
pony-2-5d-realism: A 2.5D semi-realistic anime look: crisp anime outlines over volumetric, near-photographic gradient shading, smoothly blended highlights and a polished finish halfway between cel and painting.
pop-art: A 1960s pop-art look: flat punchy colour fields, crisp black outlines, mechanical halftone dot patterns instead of shading and a silkscreen commercial-print finish.
poster-art: A mid-century print-poster look: bold simplified shapes, flat or minimally graded colour with strong punch, economical detail and a clear graphic hierarchy with a printed matte finish.
ps1-graphics: A mid-1990s 32-bit console 3D look: blocky jittering vertex-snapped polygons, low-resolution warped textures, harsh pixelated edges without anti-aliasing and flat limited lighting.
psychological-thriller-pulp-digital-pain: A pulp-paperback digital-painting look: dramatic chiaroscuro light slicing through darkness, saturated deep noir colour grading and loose expressive painterly brushwork rather than photoreal edges.
quilling: A paper-quilling look: tightly coiled and scrolled paper strips assembled into raised filigree patterns, soft shadows where coiled edges stand off the ground and a delicate handcrafted precision.
rembrandt-inspired-photography: A baroque chiaroscuro photography look: a single high side light leaving a small lit triangle on the shadow side, warm umber, gold and near-black tones and dark minimal backgrounds.
rembrandt-painting: A baroque old-master oil-painting look: single-source warm chiaroscuro, umber and near-black depths, thick impasto in the lit passages against thin glazed shadows.
rick-and-morty-style: An adult-sitcom cartoon look: wobbly slightly rubbery uniform linework, simple flat fills with minimal shading, elastic shapes and a scrappy digital-puppet animation finish.
robin-eley-style: A hyperrealist oil-painting look: translucent wrapped plastic rendered with uncanny precision, cool clinical studio light catching every crease and refraction and neutral plain backgrounds.
rossdraws-style: A glowing digital-painting look: bold confident brushwork, crisp focal rendering dissolving into loose atmospheric edges, soft bloom and glow accents and saturated rim-light colour.
rubber-hose-cartoon: A 1930s rubber-hose cartoon look: smooth tubular jointless curves, thick uniform black outlines, flat minimal shading and a vintage black-and-white or faded print finish.
ryan-benjamin-style: A gritty painted-comic look: heavy inking blended into painterly digital colour, richly textured surfaces, sharp directional light with deep shadows and desaturated grounds punctuated by bold accent light.
sailor-moon-style: A 1990s magical-girl cel-anime look: delicate linework, soft cel shading with dreamy glow and starburst sparkles, glossy layered highlights and pastel pinks, lilacs and sky blues.
saul-steinberg-art: A witty magazine-cartoon look: economical single-line continuous-contour ink drawing, restrained precise linework and muted, understated gouache tones on plain paper.
scribble-fine-art: A gestural scribble-abstraction look: layered freeform scribbled graphite and crayon lines accumulating into form and texture, visible improvised construction and a balance of chaos and control.
selfie-photo: A casual smartphone-snapshot look: slight wide-angle distortion, soft flat front-facing diffused light, natural unpolished handheld exposure and the crisp, lightly processed digital finish of a phone sensor.
shindol-style: A polished webtoon look: clean inked linework, soft cel-shaded gradients, smooth luminous surfaces with glossy layered highlights, gentle ambient studio-like light and warm blushed accents.
simpsons-style: A prime-time sitcom cartoon look: thick confident outlines, lumpy bulbous simplified shapes, bright flat fills with no gradient and saturated yellows, sky blues and primary accents.
sin-city-photography: A stark noir graphic-novel photography look: razor-sharp black-and-white extremes, deep inky blacks, glowing white rim highlights and a single element in bold selective colour.
sitcom-still: A multi-camera television-studio look: bright flat high-key lighting minimizing shadows, even three-point coverage, clean consistent exposure and a comfortable broadcast-video polish.
sketch: A raw observational sketch look: loose gestural graphite or charcoal lines, visible construction lines and searching strokes, quick cross-hatching or light smudging and bare paper left unfinished.
soft-beauty-dish-portrait-rendering: A beauty-dish studio photography look: soft wrapping almost shadowless light, smooth falloff with subtle modelling, round glossy catchlights and refined high-end retouching.
solo-leveling-art: A high-impact action-webtoon look: hyper-detailed digital rendering, saturated dark palettes cut by glowing violet, blue or crimson auras, sharp specular highlights and crisp motion lines.
south-park-style: A crude construction-paper cutout look: rigid flat geometric shapes, thick outlines, flat uniform colour blocks with almost no shading and a stiff, deliberately unpolished digital-cutout finish.
soviet-propaganda-poster: A constructivist propaganda-poster look: stark flat colour fields with heavy outlines, sculptural simplified forms, bold diagonals and a restricted red, black, cream and ochre lithographic palette.
splatterpunk-horror-illustration: An extreme horror-zine look: dense chaotic ink mark-making, harsh high-contrast rendering in engulfing black, crude raw texture with splattered ink and blood-red accents.
stained-glass-flat-art: A stained-glass look: bold flat colour regions enclosed by dark lead-like dividing lines, no volumetric shading, ornamental segmented patterning and radiant jewel-toned colour glowing as if backlit.
steven-universe-style: A soft flat-cartoon look: gentle rounded geometric shapes, even flat colour with only soft contact shadows, low tonal contrast and painterly pastel backgrounds.
stranger-things-inspired-art: A 1980s genre-film look: thick atmospheric haze, a single saturated light source piercing through, harsh directional flares against soft ambient glow and retro VHS-like film grain.
streamer-glam-selfie-realism: A creator-culture glam photography look: soft ring-light illumination, RGB accent lighting, dreamy fairy-light bokeh, pastel colour casts and immaculate, polished beauty retouching.
surveillance-camera-photo: A CCTV security-footage look: flat unflattering automated light, grainy low-resolution compression artefacts, slight wide-angle distortion and a cold, washed-out impersonal colour.
technical-drawing: A precise technical-drawing look: exact mechanical linework with consistent line-weight logic, little or no shading, orthographic drafting clarity and clean monochrome lines on plain paper.
tenebrism: A tenebrist baroque oil-painting look: extreme contrast between engulfing darkness and a single sharp pool of light, forms emerging abruptly from shadow and refined brushwork only in the lit passages.
thin-delicate-outline-romantic-anime-pho: A soft anime-photographic hybrid look: impossibly fine barely-there outlines over photographically convincing tonal depth and light, delicate gradient transitions and soft-focus, gently graded colour.
tim-burton-style: A gothic macabre illustration look: elongated spindly angular forms, nervous sketchy hand-drawn linework, curling spirals and stripes and high-contrast graphic shading in a dark, desaturated palette.
travis-charest-style: A hyper-glossy painted-comic look: immaculately smooth glassy gradients with no visible brushwork, ultra-fine detailed linework beneath, sharp polished highlights and a slick reflective sheen.
ultrarealism: An ultrarealist oil-painting look: hyper-precise minute detail beyond photographic fidelity, controlled dramatic lighting, obsessive layered glazing for depth and translucency and hyper-vivid tonal subtlety.
van-gogh-style: A post-impressionist oil-painting look: thick directional impasto strokes swirling across every surface, saturated cobalt and chrome-yellow contrasts built from layered unblended marks.
variable-size-ben-day-dots-illustration: A pop-art print look: tone built entirely from halftone dots that grow larger in the shadows and shrink in the lights, crisp bold outlines and slight offset-print registration texture.
vector-art: A crisp vector-art look: mathematically precise Bézier linework, evenly bounded colour regions with smooth gradients or flat fills, razor-sharp edges and no painterly texture.
victo-ngai-style: A luminous decorative gouache look: richly patterned ornamental linework, soft glowing colour transitions, dense intricate focal detail balanced with negative space and ukiyo-e and miniature-style patterning.
vintage-children-s-book-drawing: A vintage storybook look: soft hand-inked lines, delicate muted gouache and watercolour washes, rounded shapes and slightly faded paper with limited-run print colours.
vintage-comics: A golden-age comic-book look: confident inked linework, coarse halftone dots instead of shading, yellowed newsprint paper, slight colour misregistration and a worn offset-print texture.
vogue-magazine: A high-fashion editorial photography look: crisp immaculately controlled studio light, striking directional key light carving sharp definition, glossy luxury retouching and a flawless print finish.
watercolor-anime-illustration: A watercolour anime look: clean anime linework over delicate translucent washes, gentle bleeding and soft edges, patiently layered tones and soft directional light with a dreamy finish.
wet-on-wet-watercolor-ink-painting: A wet-on-wet watercolour look: pigment blooming and bleeding into saturated paper, soft feathered edges with no crisp boundaries and delicate translucent layered washes with ink accents.
wojak-meme-sketch-style: A crude internet-meme doodle look: wobbly mouse-drawn or ballpoint contours, almost no shading, deliberately amateur flat shapes and plain flat white backgrounds.
woodcut: A woodcut relief-print look: bold gouged lines carved from negative space, stark black-and-white contrast with almost no midtones and rough hand-pressed ink edges.
x-ray-style: A radiographic x-ray look: translucent layered structures glowing from within, precise clinical internal linework, stark contrast between dense and translucent areas on a deep blue-black ground.
yoshitaka-amano-style: An ethereal ink-and-wash fantasy look: delicate flowing elongated linework, translucent washes bleeding softly into one another, generous empty space and fine art nouveau ornament in flowing strands.
zelda-wind-waker-style: A bright toon-shaded game look: crisp hard-edged cel shading, thick clean outlines, rounded chunky geometry, matte painterly skies and stylized swirling cloud, wind and water effects.
zenescope-illustration: A glossy variant-cover fantasy-comic look: refined digital rendering balancing realism and stylization, luxurious material textures, intricate ornamental detail and sophisticated dramatic lighting with vibrant colour.
